title: Sam's Terrible Saturday
subtitle: Past simple: verbos regulares e irregulares

content.instructions: Completa con el past simple del verbo entre paréntesis.

items.text: Last Saturday was a terrible day for Sam. He ___ (wake up) late because his phone ___ (not / ring). He ___ (run) to the bathroom, but Priya was already in the shower.
items.hint: Wake → woke, run → ran. Negativa: didn't + infinitivo.

items.text: He ___ (make) a coffee, but there ___ (be) no milk in the fridge. So he ___ (go) to the shop in his pyjamas. He felt really embarrassed. The shop assistant ___ (look) at him and ___ (smile).
items.hint: There was + singular / incontable (milk). Look y smile son regulares: -ed.

items.text: In the afternoon Sam ___ (take) his guitar to The Old Duke for a concert. On the way, it ___ (start) to rain and he ___ (not / have) an umbrella. He stepped in a big puddle and he ___ (arrive) at the pub soaked.
items.hint: Take → took. Negativa: didn't + infinitivo (have, no had).

items.text: "___ (you / play) well?" Lucía ___ (ask) him the next day. "Well, I ___ (forget) the words of the first song," Sam said, "but the people ___ (love) it. They ___ (think) it was a joke!"
items.hint: Pregunta: did + sujeto + infinitivo. Forget → forgot, think → thought.

vocabulary.definition: clothes that you wear in bed
feeling silly because other people saw you do something
a small pool of rainwater on the ground
